name: Вещица рън
location: Игрището, поляна над с. Извос, Белоградчик, Bulgaria
description: “Witch Run” is a themed recreational run in the Belogradchik area, organized by BG Events & Guiding. In a previous edition, participants covered a 15-kilometer route, part of which was dedicated to the witch theme and flying on broomsticks. The event combines outdoor activity with a festive atmosphere and themed surprises.
course_highlights: A 15-kilometer route in the Belogradchik area, according to information about a previous edition
A themed 2-kilometer section dedicated to flying on broomsticks
Starting location in a previous edition: the meadow above the village of Izvos, known as “The Playing Field”
additional: The available information refers to previous editions and does not confirm details about the race on 29.11.2026.

name: XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race on the 5kmrun calendar, held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—6 km, 12 km, and 18 km—suitable for different levels of fitness. The event offers the opportunity to run in a natural setting on varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. It is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the surrounding region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating climbs and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow participants to choose according to their abilities and preferred level of exertion. The race is part of the XLkmrun winter calendar and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running.

name: Nikulden Trail Run
location: Sports Hall Nikola Petrov, Gorna Oryahovitsa, Bulgaria
description: Nikuldен Trail Run 2026 is a traditional trail-running race held in the town of Gorna Oryahovitsa, starting from the Nikola Petrov Sports Hall. Organized by SC Brown Team and SCO Kamaka, the race offers two main distances—11 km with 350 meters of elevation gain and 19 km with 750 meters of elevation gain—as well as a 2 km children’s race. The courses pass through technical terrain including Kamaka, the Rahovets Fortress, and the Chuypetel rock formation. Some sections are also used for the long courses of Tarnovo Ultra. The event is suitable for runners experienced in mountain running and offers participation across different age categories.
course_highlights: Technical terrain at Kamaka, the Rahovets Fortress, and the Chuypetel rock formation
Two main distances: 11 km (350 m elevation gain) and 19 km (750 m elevation gain)
A 2 km children’s race with 75 meters of elevation gain
additional: On-site registration is available for a limited number of participants. Trail shoes with aggressive tread are mandatory due to the technical sections and the possibility of snow. A long-sleeved top is recommended when temperatures are below 10 degrees. Bib pickup is from 09:00 to 10:45 in the conference hall at Lokomotiv Stadium; race briefing is at 10:55 in front of the sports hall. The awards ceremony and closing will take place by 14:30 at the start/finish area. The start and finish are at the Nikola Petrov Sports Hall. Trail shoes with aggressive tread are mandatory. The children’s race is for age groups up to 8, up to 10, and up to 12 years.

name: Коледно бягане I 2026
description: Christmas Run I 2026 in Tulbe Park, Kazanlak, is a festive, friendly event bringing together runners and enthusiasts for an easy, enjoyable 6 km route with no elevation gain. The event is non-competitive and untimed. Its main goal is to get moving before the holidays, share smiles, and enjoy a cheerful atmosphere. Participation is free with advance registration, and the festive dress code and prize raffle add to the occasion. It’s an ideal place for families and runners of all levels to enjoy exercise and the holiday spirit.
course_highlights: Easy, enjoyable 6 km route with no elevation gain
Mostly asphalt and dirt road
Route suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: The event is completely free, but advance registration is required. It is non-competitive and untimed, and participants take part at their own risk. A festive dress code is planned, with Christmas hats, reindeer antlers, and other accessories. A raffle will be held, with prizes including vouchers for other races in 2027. Participants are advised to arrive 15–20 minutes before the start for warm-up and photos. Advance registration is required.

name: ПОЛУМАРАТОН НЕСЕБЪР
description: The Nessebar Half Marathon is your epic finale to the year’s races, held during the magical Christmas season in Nessebar. The course is one of the fastest and most scenic in Bulgaria, combining the beauty of the blue sea with the majestic Balkan Mountains. The cobbled streets of centuries-old Nessebar create a unique atmosphere, while nature brings different surprises each year, making the race one of a kind. It is the last race of the year, with excellent organization and a wonderful experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A fast, scenic course combining the sea and mountains
A magical atmosphere in Nessebar’s cobbled streets
A Christmas-season race with unique surprises from nature
additional: Children up to 14 years old can participate in any distance free of charge. Race packs are distributed on 19.12 from 10:00 to 18:00 and on 20.12 from 07:00 to 09:00. On 19.12, there is a guided walk organized by the Ancient Nessebar Museum from 14:00 to 15:00. The race starts at 10:00. On 19 December, race-pack distribution and a guided walk organized by the Ancient Nessebar Museum are scheduled. Packs are also distributed on race day from 07:00 to 09:00.

name: Kalikantzaros Trail Run
location: Summer Cinema, Valley of Agion Anargiron, Serres, Greece
organizer: Организационният комитет на KALIKANTZAROS TRAIL, Асоциацията на маратонците в Серес и община Серес
description: Kalikantzaros Trail Run offers an authentic experience on the mountain trails of Serres, Greece. The race features two routes of different lengths and difficulty levels, suitable for runners of all abilities. The 21 km half marathon follows technical trails and requires physical endurance, while the 8 km route is easier and suitable for beginners. The race takes place in the picturesque Agion Anargiron Valley and offers unique views and outdoor challenges.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon with technical trails and +350 m elevation gain
8 km route with 85% trails, 5% asphalt and 10% forest road
Three hydration points on the half-marathon route
additional: Race bibs can be collected the day before the race (10:00–14:00) and on race day (08:00–10:30). On-site last-minute registration is also available. The half marathon has a 4-hour time limit, while the 8 km route has a 2-hour limit. Prizes are awarded to the top runners overall and in each category. For the 22 km distance, a 4-hour time limit and mandatory gear apply; the 8 km limit is 3 hours. Support stations are provided along the routes.

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he travelled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances with varying difficulty and elevation gain are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths travelled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while unregistered participants can send entries by email or phone. Race numbers can be collected from the secretariat until 11:00, and on-site registration is available until 10:30 if race numbers remain. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the start and run along red markings. The masters’ start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; entries are accepted in advance, and on-site registration is available if race numbers remain. The date listed in the sources for 2026 is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

description: Road Races Plovdiv 2027 will take place on March 6 and 7 at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv. The event offers three distances—1 mile, 5 km, and 10 km—suitable for runners of different levels. Organized by SC ACTIVE 2013, the race includes electronic timing, aid stations, medical assistance, and awards for the overall standings. Participants receive a unique medal, a race pack with lots of gifts, and the chance to enter a raffle for prizes. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with a host, photographers, and volunteers helping ensure everyone enjoys the event and that it runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The course is at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv, with a flat, fast profile
Aid stations and a medical team along the course
Chip-based electronic timing and official individual results
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with an electronic timing chip, a unique designer medal, insurance, entry in a raffle with more than 32 prizes, gifts from partners, water and refreshments at the finish, and an electronic certificate of completion. Late registration is possible if places are available and closes before the relevant start. The organizers have removed the mandatory declarations from the website and provide them pre-filled when participants collect their race packs. Payment is by bank transfer.

name: OPPENING SEASON Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling 2027
location: Meadow above the Rakia Still, Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park (Ayazmoto), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“ – Стара Загора
description: OPENING SEASON Ultra Trail Run & XCM Cycling 2027 is a signature sporting event that opens the sports season in Stara Zagora. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event offers a range of disciplines—ultra trail running and cross-country cycling. The start and finish are at the clearing above the rakia still in Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto). Participants can choose from several distances of varying difficulty and marking, suitable for both beginners and advanced athletes.
course_highlights: A dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
A moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange, featuring the challenges of Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration opens at 06:30 and continues until 08:30, with collection of race packs and bibs with timing chips. The technical briefing is from 08:30 to 08:50. The cycling start (XCM and E-Bike) is at 09:00, and the running start is at 09:30. The main awards ceremony is at 17:00. The distances are marked with colored ribbons and include both running and cycling. There are special categories for electric bikes and age groups. Helmets are mandatory for cyclists.

name: OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains around the village of Markovo, Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22, and 44 km—as well as a 700-meter children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food, and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance, and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo Town Hall and organized by the Plovdiv and Rhodopa Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Clubs.

name: Велинград Ултра
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon offering three challenging courses in Velingrad, the spa capital of the Balkans. Participants can choose between 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event includes professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.

name: Панагюрище ултра
description: Panagyurishte Ultra is a mountain running and cycling race held in the heart of Sredna Gora near Panagyurishte. The event brings together people who love being active and seek challenges on forest and dirt roads, with varying distances and elevation gains. Participants can choose from several distances, offering unique views and the chance to connect with nature and test their own abilities. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and community spirit, and offers support along the course as well as prizes for finishers.
course_highlights: After the first kilometer of paved road, the routes follow forest and dirt roads exclusively
Distances of varying lengths and elevation gains, from 12 km to 61 km
A combination of mountain running and cycling, with beautiful views and challenges
additional: The entry fee includes an event T-shirt, a race number with a chip, electronic timing and results, medical support, course markings, water and food at aid stations, a finisher's medal, and gifts from sponsors. Participants must be at least 14 years old, and those aged 14 to 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. Competitors must arrive at the race-number and chip collection point at least 30 minutes before the start. The event includes trail running and mountain biking disciplines.

name: Kaylaka Trail Run 2026
description: Kaylaka Trail Run 2026 is the fourth edition of a mountain race in Kaylaka Nature Park in Pleven. The event offers four distances—7 km, 16 km, 21 km, and 30 km—on scenic forest trails, steep hills, and rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River. The event combines sport, nature, and a cause, with part of the funds raised donated to improve the park’s infrastructure. Every finisher receives a specially made medal, a symbol of perseverance and the strength that comes from the forest.
course_highlights: Scenic forest trails and rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River
Routes with challenging climbs and descents, suitable for beginners and experienced trail runners alike
Water and food stations at various points along the routes
additional: Distances: 7 km (also suitable for walkers and children), 16 km, 21 km, and 30 km. The terrain includes asphalt, forest roads, and hiking nature trails. Water and food stations are located at key points along the routes. Every participant receives a special medal. The event supports improvements to the infrastructure in Kaylaka Park. The event is dedicated to caring for nature and Kaylaka Park.

name: МАДАРА TRAIL 2026
description: Madara Trail 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Madara, Shumen Municipality. The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, suitable for both recreational runners and experienced trail runners. Participants must wear trail shoes, and those running the 30 km distance must carry containers for water and food. The event is organized by Shumen Early Runners, and participants must complete informed consent forms.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural surroundings of the village of Madara
Three distances: 13 km, 21 km, and 30 km
Trail shoes and equipment are required
additional: Mandatory equipment for all participants: trail running shoes. Participants in the 30 km race must carry water containers with a capacity of at least 500 ml and food. Completing informed consent forms is mandatory. For the 30 km distance, participants must carry a water container with a capacity of at least 500 ml and food. Trail running shoes are mandatory.

name: Кайлъка трейл рън '27
location: Totlebenov Val Reservoir, Kaylaka Park, Pleven, Bulgaria
organizer: Сдружение „Да бягаш“ в партньорство с Община Плевен
description: Kaylaka Trail Run is a mountain race in Kaylaka Nature Park, Pleven, combining sport, nature, and a cause. The race offers four distances—7 km, 16 km, 21 km, and 30 km—along scenic forest trails, steep hills, and rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River. The courses are suitable for beginners as well as experienced trail runners. The event supports improvements to the park’s infrastructure and promotes a connection between people and nature. Everyone who finishes receives a specially made medal, a symbol of perseverance and the strength of the forest.
course_highlights: Scenic forest trails and steep hills
Rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River
Varied surfaces—pavement, forest roads, and hiking eco-trails
additional: Water and food stations are located along the courses. The 7 km course is suitable for runners, walkers, and children. The 30 km course starts at the Totlebenov Val Reservoir and passes historical and natural landmarks such as the Storgozia Fortress and the Dead Valley. The surface is about 6% pavement, with the rest consisting of forest roads and eco-trails. In the previous edition, the start and finish were at the Totlebenov Val Reservoir.

name: Tarnovo Ultra 2026
location: Parking at Boris Denev Art Gallery, Assenevtsi Monument, Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 55 km, 51 km, 35 km, 32 km, 25 km, 14 km
description: Tarnovo Ultra 2026 offers a unique race in the heart of Veliko Tarnovo, with 10 disciplines including mountain biking, trail running and duathlon. The routes pass along beautiful trails and offer breathtaking views, including a passage through two medieval fortresses. The finish is at the Asenevtsi Monument, overlooking the historic part of the city, making this the only race in Bulgaria to finish in the centre of a regional city. The event is organised by Brown Team Sports Club, which guarantees a high standard of organisation and a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: The routes pass through two medieval fortresses
Breathtaking views and trails with varied terrain
The finish is in the centre of Veliko Tarnovo, at the Asenevtsi Monument
additional: The race offers 10 disciplines: three MTB distances (24, 35 and 55 km) on 10 April, four trail distances (14, 25, 32 and 51 km) on 11 April, and three duathlons combining MTB and trail distances. The routes have varied terrain and a challenging profile, with excellent course marking. The organiser is Brown Team Sports Club, a member of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation. The programme also includes MTB distances of 24, 35 and 55 km, as well as a short and a long duathlon and a children's duathlon.

name: Kom Epic в града
description: KOM EPIC in the City is a mass urban race in the center of Berkovitsa and around the city stadium. The event offers three distances—3.5 km, 7 km, and a 1 km children’s race—with a shared start and finish in the city center. The course includes a red route of about 3.5 km, with a loop around the stadium that serves as a special speed segment, and a blue route for the children’s race in the city center. The event is suitable for both professionals and amateurs, who start together in a mass start.
course_highlights: A red route of about 3.5 km with a loop around the city stadium
A 1 km speed segment around the stadium for recording the fastest kilometer
A 1 km children’s race in the city center on a blue route
additional: The cutoff time is 45 minutes for 3.5 km and 1 hour and 20 minutes for 7 km. Payments can be made by bank transfer or through Easypay, providing a reference number to link the payment to the registration. Cutoff times of 45 minutes for 3.5 km and 1 hour and 20 minutes for 7 km apply. The event is held in partnership with Berkovitsa Municipality.

name: Ямбол Рън / Yambol Run
description: Yambol Run is a sporting event that brings together athletes and sports enthusiasts in the city of Yambol. The competition includes different age groups and activities for children, with the aim of encouraging an active lifestyle and sports culture in the community. The event is held under the auspices of Yambol Municipality and offers everyone interested the opportunity to take part.

description: Plovdiv Marathon Weekend brings together a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and corporate relay, with the start and finish at Plovdiv Rowing Canal. The courses are internationally certified to World Athletics and AIMS standards, passing along the Maritsa River and through the city center. The event offers opportunities for both experienced runners and beginners, with a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere. Participants receive race kits with a medal, T-shirt and travel vouchers. The three-day program includes races and entertainment for all ages.
course_highlights: Internationally certified courses to World Athletics and AIMS standards
The marathon consists of two laps of the half-marathon course, which passes along the Maritsa River and through central Plovdiv
The 5 km and corporate relay take place on a flat course near the Rowing Canal
additional: Race kits are distributed on Friday and Saturday. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, medal, T-shirt (for the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon), water, isotonic drinks and fruit along the course, medical assistance and insurance for race day, as well as food and drinks at the finish. Each participant receives travel vouchers worth €300. The corporate relay is for four participants, each running a 1.25 km leg. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, and finishers receive a medal; drinks, fruit, medical assistance and insurance for race day are provided.

name: Plovdiv Run
location: Plovdiv Rowing Canal (Гребна база), Plovdiv, Bulgaria
price_range: Корпоративна щафета: €40 на човек; таксите за останалите дистанции не са посочени.
description: Plovdiv Run is an event featuring a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and corporate relay, with the start and finish at Plovdiv Rowing Canal. The courses are internationally certified according to World Athletics and AIMS standards, passing along the Maritsa River and through the center of Plovdiv, offering a unique combination of sport and culture. Participants can enjoy a variety of distances suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, with the opportunity to take part in races throughout the weekend. The organizers provide race packs with medals, T-shirts, food and drinks, as well as medical assistance and insurance.
course_highlights: Internationally certified courses according to World Athletics and AIMS standards
Two laps for the marathon and one for the half marathon, along the Maritsa River and through the center of Plovdiv
Start and finish at Plovdiv Rowing Canal, with flat and scenic courses
additional: Race packs are distributed on Friday and Saturday. The race pack includes a race bib with chip, medal, T-shirt (for the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon), water, isotonic drinks and fruit along the course, medical assistance and insurance for race day, as well as food and drinks at the finish. Every participant receives travel vouchers worth €300 from Equator BG. Race packs are collected on Friday and Saturday. The corporate relay is for four participants, with each person running 1.25 km. The entry fee includes a race bib with chip, a finisher’s medal, drinks, food at the finish and medical assistance. Every registered participant receives travel vouchers worth a total of €300.

name: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Великденски Маратон 2026
organizer: СНЦ Клуб за колоездене и туризъм „Зарата“
price_range: от €14 до €31, в зависимост от категорията и датата на регистрация
description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sporting event in Stara Zagora featuring trail running and mountain biking. Organized by the Zaratа Cycling and Tourism Club Association, with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality and TD Sarnena Gora, the competition offers various running and cycling distances in Ayazmoto Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Trail running and mountain biking in Ayazmoto Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km and 38 km (ultra)
eBike MTB cycling at up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra course
additional: Registration and race-number pickup from 07:00 to 08:00. Cyclists must wear helmets. Payment is accepted only by bank transfer or at an EasyPay counter after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI card holders). Awards ceremony at 17:00 for both disciplines. The cycling courses will include an approximately 32 km hobby course and a 42 km ultra course; online registration, payment by bank transfer; valid insurance and helmets are required for cyclists.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletics talents. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the region’s nature and attractions. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment. The event is aimed at people who love sport and nature.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000m Track Championships in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s best athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometer distance on the track. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and cage-free shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social connections.

name: МЕЧИ ЧАЛ ТРЕЙЛ 2027
description: Mechi Chal Trail 2027 is a mountain race offering varied routes through the beautiful Rhodope Mountains, with an authentic Rhodope atmosphere. The race takes place on 25 April 2027 in Chepelare, with the start and finish at Olympic Square. Participants can choose from four distances of varying lengths and difficulty, featuring mountain routes and forest trails. The event is organized by SK AKTIV 2013, which provides full event organization, support, and prize money for all distances. The event also features a raffle with numerous prizes, a special hat, and many surprises for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Four distances: 8 km, 16.5 km, 25 km, and 38.3 km
Start and finish at Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Race packets are also distributed on the day before the race (24.04.27). The event includes aid stations, a medical team, photographers, an event host, volunteers, and special course marking. Every participant receives a medal, a race bib with an electronic timing chip, a unique special hat, and entry into a raffle with more than 35 prizes. The registration fee includes insurance and numerous gifts from partners. The fee includes a medal, a race bib with an electronic timing chip, insurance, aid stations, and a medical team.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a 10 km route suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the Begach sports club and attracts more participants every year.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of the town of Bankya and heading toward Ostrа Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The route crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, which offers panoramic views of Sofia. The course continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is an excellent strength and endurance workout, suitable for preparing for long distances and running in mountain conditions.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls is held in the village of Bistritsa, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain run suitable for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors, with communication handled directly with them. The event is a traditional one and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience on mountain terrain.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.

name: Коджа Кая
description: Kozha Kaya is the first fully self-supported ultramarathon in Bulgaria, held in the village of Bilka, Burgas. The course offers challenges at various distances, including 75 km with 4,400 metres of elevation gain, a 42 km marathon, 30 km Sky, and shorter options—all without aid stations. The race is a true test of endurance and skill, with participants required to finish before sunset. The location is remarkable for its rich flora, stunning views, and steep peaks, creating an unforgettable adventure for every runner.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4,400 m of elevation gain, without aid stations
42 km marathon with over 2,700 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
Routes through green forests, steep peaks, and colourful landscapes
additional: All distances are fully self-supported, with no aid stations. There is also an additional 3.6 km speed race with 500 m of elevation gain. The race takes place on 24–25 April 2027 in the village of Bilka, Burgas.

name: МарицаРън 2026
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants can enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over €1,500.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with different elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and merchandise prizes.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as under-20, under-18 and under-16 boys and girls, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.

name: Sri Chinmoy Run and Become Marathon
description: On May 2, 2027, the first official Sri Chinmoy Run and Become Marathon, organized by the Run and Become Athletics Club, will take place in South Park in Sofia. The event was created with the mission of bringing together people who love movement, challenges, and personal growth, regardless of their level of training. The course is a 2 km asphalt loop in South Park, where participants can enjoy a supportive atmosphere and sporting spirit. The organizers offer excellent services, including timing, medals, certificates, and professional photos.
course_highlights: A 2 km asphalt loop in South Park
Start and finish in South Park, Sofia
Course preparation and safety measures
additional: Race numbers can be collected on April 29, 30, and May 1, 2027, from 8:00 to 13:00 at a location near the “Outdoor Fitness” area in South Park. Participant packages include a race number with a timing chip, a medal, digital and printed certificates, trophies for the winners, refreshments and snacks, a DryFit T-shirt for the 42K and 21K distances, bag storage, professional photos, and timing. Race packages include a timing chip, a medal, a certificate, photos, drinks, and snacks. A DryFit T-shirt is listed for participants in the 42 km and 21 km distances.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria and takes place in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race is run on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance over 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow runners.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
location: Sinite Kamani Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: The Haidushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants race up the iconic trail from its starting point to the large fountain by Karandila Hotel. The route offers different variations of varying difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize money; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who completes the climb in under 1 hour. It is a unique challenge for mountain-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
location: Сините камъни Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: Yunashki Games 2026 take place in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honor of the birthday of Hadji Dimitar and St. George’s Day—the Day of Courage. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the haiduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. The event is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Youth” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This event has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from various countries to compete in a range of track and field disciplines. The tournament supports the development of youth sport and gives talented athletes under 18 the opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize the importance of registered performances for participation in certain disciplines, such as the girls’ long jump.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running event held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The event offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Rui, Ezimir, and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for the Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around the Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and includes three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final Via Ferrata climb. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all funds raised go toward restoring the hut. It’s an opportunity to test your strength against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held in the area of the village of Zheleznitsa, near Sofia. The course is just over 5 km long and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb, and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometer covered, Amusnet donates €5 to support the cause, which helps Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Tran Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turakovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forest areas. Organized by the Tran Tourist Society with the support of Tran Municipality, the race provides course marking, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
location: Yailata Archaeological Reserve, Kamen Bryag, Kavarna, Bulgaria
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging running race held along the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern Black Sea coast. Participants can choose between three distances—42 km, 17 km, and 7 km—each offering a unique experience with sea views and impressive natural landscapes. The event takes place in the area of Yailata and Kamen Bryag, with the course passing iconic natural and cultural landmarks. Sunrise Ultra combines sport, nature, and culture, and also offers a special T-shirt and medal symbolizing the spirit of the race.
course_highlights: 42 km with 900 m of elevation gain along a rugged coastline
17 km with 390 m of elevation gain along rocky shores and sea views
The course passes through the Yailata Nature Reserve and Cape Shabla
additional: To receive a race packet, participants must sign a participation and personal data protection declaration, which can be signed electronically on-site. Bus transport to the starting points is provided for all distances. The Finisher medal is awarded only to those who successfully finish within the cutoff time. The maximum time for 42 km is 6:30 hours; for 17 km, it is 3:00 hours.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race and part of the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place near the village of Plana, close to Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—which cross open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. The race attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nинеva. The event is part of the Municipality of Lukovit’s sports calendar and offers a mass start over 800 meters for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The jubilee 20th edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, providing opportunities for young talents and established competitors to showcase their skills. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports figures.

name: Маратон "Розова долина" - Rose Valley Marathon
description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for everyone who enjoys running. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity among the population and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: the classic marathon (42 km), the half marathon (21 km), and 10 km. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak. The event takes place in May 2027.
course_highlights: The course passes through Bulgaria’s beautiful Rose Valley
Start and finish in Rosarium Park, in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak
Aid stations with water, drinks, and fruit every 5 km
additional: Race packs can be collected only after each participant or their parent has signed a participation declaration. The start/finish area has designated zones for personal belongings, with stickers bearing each participant’s number. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00. Awards are presented in age and gender categories. Aid stations are located approximately every 5 km along the course.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near the Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers various categories, including individual races and mixed relays of different durations, making it suitable for a wide range of participants. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, provide a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity for a sporting challenge in nature. The event takes place every year and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: Terrain around Shumen Reservoir
Options for individual running and mixed relays
Different time categories—from 1 to 6 hours
additional: The race includes individual 6-hour and 3-hour runs, as well as mixed relays lasting 2 hours and 1 hour (for participants under 18).

name: Business Run Varna
description: IHB Business Run Varna is the largest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of four, with each participant running 4 km before passing the baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.

name: Студентите бягат с УАСГ
location: Intersection of Hristo and Evlogi Georgiev Boulevard and Hristo Smirnenski Boulevard, Sofia, Bulgaria
organizer: Университет по архитектура, строителство и геодезия (УАСГ)
description: Students Run with UACEG is an annual event that brings participants together for a 5-kilometer race in Sofia. The race takes place at the intersection of Hristo and Evlogi Georgievi boulevards and Hristo Smirnenski Boulevard, offering a sporting challenge and a social event for the student community and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer distance
Urban route in central Sofia
Start and finish at the intersection of Hristo and Evlogi Georgievi Boulevard and Hristo Smirnenski Boulevard
additional: The funds raised by the race will support students battling cancer.

name: ApriltsiRun
location: ул. „Цанко Дюстабанов“ 12, квартал Острец, Априлци, Bulgaria
description: ApriltsiRun – In the Footsteps of the Heroes is a charity mountain race in Apriltsi, inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race offers various distances suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beautiful Balkan landscapes and historic sites in the Central Balkan region. The funds raised support health initiatives, cultural heritage preservation, and local healthcare. Participants become part of a community that combines the sporting challenge with care for people and the region’s history.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes and forest trails in the natural surroundings of the Central Balkan region
Views of Maragidik and Mount Botev
Inspired by the Novosel Uprising and the April Uprising
additional: Distances: 3 km (75 m elevation gain), 8 km (182 m elevation gain), 13 km (340 m elevation gain), 28 km (1,580 m elevation gain). Children aged 7 to 16 and people with disabilities may participate in the 3 km distance free of charge. Mandatory equipment for the longer distances includes a waterproof jacket in poor weather conditions. The use of trekking poles is permitted.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the maritime capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit that inspires participants to achieve new personal goals.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Friendship Marathon Pleven is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The race includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and the Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. Organizers provide aid stations, medical services, and a full program for race day.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon event held at the foot of the Stara Planina Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginner and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is an annual event held in the village of Sinemorets, in the heart of Strandzha Nature Park. The trail-running and mountain-biking routes offer scenic trails through the wilderness of southeastern Bulgaria, with distances from 3 to 42 km for runners and cyclists. The event combines sport, nature, and adventure, attracting participants of different ages and fitness levels. The marathon takes place over two days and includes running and mountain-biking races, as well as special children’s distances. Organizers provide support along the course with isotonic drinks and fresh fruit, and the event concludes with an awards ceremony and a party.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in Strandzha Nature Park
Loop courses starting and finishing at Veleka Beach
Aid stations with fresh fruit and isotonic drinks
additional: The running races start at 09:00, with different distances and cut-off times. Mountain biking takes place the following day, with distances of 21 and 43 km. Electric bikes are prohibited. Participants must carry a water container; refills are available along the course. For environmental reasons, the organizers do not provide plastic bottles. There is a special 3 km distance for children. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a raffle, followed by a party at Koraba Bar.

name: Международен турнир "Пловдив"
description: The “Plovdiv” International Tournament is an athletics competition organized by the Botev Plovdiv Athletics Club with the support of Plovdiv Municipality. The competition aims to promote athletics in the region and attracts competitors from Bulgaria and abroad. The program includes a variety of events, such as sprint races, jumps, and pole vault, held at Plovdiv Stadium. The tournament is a traditional event that brings athletes and sports fans together in a dynamic and friendly spirit.
course_highlights: Competitions at Plovdiv Stadium, with modern facilities
Events include 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, long jump, high jump, triple jump, and pole vault
A maximum of 2 heats for track events, with priority given to foreign athletes and the organizing club
additional: Technical events are limited to 8 competitors, selected according to their personal bests for 2023/24. Track events are limited to a maximum of 2 heats, with up to 16 competitors. Contact: Stoyko Tsonov, phone 0876117789.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with stunning views and challenges. It is an event that combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The “Yordanka Arizanova” Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament is held at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes to honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking cross-country marathon (XCM) race held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying lengths and elevation gain, suitable for different categories of riders, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for intermediate and well-prepared cyclists.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wild nature of Vitosha. The race includes three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah—the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The U18 National Championships in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides an opportunity for young athletics talents to compete and develop.

name: Rhodo Rock
distance_verbose: 88 km, 60 km, Маратон, Полумаратон, 9 km, 2 km
description: Rhodo Rock is a two-day ultramarathon in the Rhodope Mountains, held near the beautiful town of Momchilgrad. The event offers five distances across two days: 88, 60, and 42 km on Saturday, and 21 and 9 km on Sunday. Participants follow varied routes through peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, making the race suitable for both professionals and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Rhodo Rock promises a unique atmosphere and an unforgettable experience amid the wild nature of the Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: A two-day race with varied routes through peaks and valleys
Crossing rivers and following forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Five distances from 9 to 88 km, suitable for different fitness levels
additional: All participants receive a finisher’s medal if they finish within the cutoff time, an original-design T-shirt, and gifts in the race pack. A mandatory medical examination is required before collecting the race pack. Medical teams are available during the event. Race timing and photography are provided.

name: Business Run Sofia
description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. Teams have 4 participants, each of whom runs 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are also a Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run. Every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active recreation with colleagues.

name: Лудогорски маратон
description: The Ludogorski Marathon takes place in the picturesque Pchelina area near Razgrad, in a protected natural area with varied terrain and beautiful woodland. The event offers running, cycling, duathlon, and triathlon disciplines. The routes are mostly forest trails and dirt roads, with a small amount of asphalt and gravel. The event is suited to nature lovers and adventure-sports enthusiasts, and provides aid stations, medical assistance, and a guarded transition area. It is organized by the Zелена стъпка (Green Step) club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is almost entirely in the forest, on unpaved forest roads and trails, with a small amount of gravel and asphalt.
The natural environment is well preserved and diverse, with the possibility of encountering wildlife.
The 25 km running course has 650 meters of elevation gain and four aid stations.
additional: The 2-kilometer children's run is free to enter, with registration on site. Checkpoints and aid stations are spaced approximately 5 kilometers apart. At the start/finish, there is a food and drink vendor, toilets, and medical assistance. The triathlon swim takes place in Pchelina Reservoir, with a rescue team on hand. Starts take place on the field with sports pitches in the Pchelina area. Finish times are limited for the different disciplines.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the picturesque Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historical landmarks. The courses offer a range of distances and challenges, suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the beauty of the region and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes through dense forests and old trails, passing close to a waterfall
Unique natural surroundings in a volcanic crater, near the Arda River and its impressive meanders
additional: Start and finish in the square in front of the Municipality in the town of Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a delicious lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for under-14 competitors in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents an opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprint races and shot put, for age groups ranging from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and opens officially at 11:00.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech, combining a sporting challenge with an opportunity to explore the region’s nature and history. Participants pass through scenic and historic places such as the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Covered Bridge, a symbol of the city. The event is suitable for anyone seeking adventure, a sporting experience, and the chance to support a charitable cause, with 20% of the fees going to the cause.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain featuring forest and country trails and asphalt (70–80% off-road, 20–30% asphalt)
Routes through historic and scenic places such as the Devetashko Plateau and Hisarya Fortress
The Covered Bridge—the emblem of Lovech, with a unique atmosphere and old-world charm
additional: Registration is available online through tracksport.live or on-site on certain days. During the final two weeks before the event, registration is subject to restrictions: no personalized race bib, and merchandise will be available on-site in the selected size. Signing a declaration is mandatory when collecting the race pack. 20% of the fees go to a charitable campaign.

name: Triglav Skyrun
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain running race held in the wild, high-altitude area of Central Balkan National Park. The courses pass iconic mountain huts and nature reserves, with the Sky distance including an ascent of Mount Golyam Kademliya (2275.4 m). The race starts in the picturesque village of Tazha, which offers impressive views of the rocky massif. The event is suited to lovers of mountain running and nature who are looking for a challenge and adventure.
course_highlights: The Sky course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
Pass through Sokolna Reserve, with its pristine nature
Climb Mount Golyam Kademliya (2275.4 m) on the Full Triglav course
additional: Race packs are distributed in the village of Tazha from 15:00 to 18:00 on the day before the race and from 6:00 on race day. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:00, with prizes and singlets for the top finishers. Participants can order a designer Triglav Skyrun 2027 singlet during registration. Participants under 18 may enter only the BASE and SHORT distances, with a signed parental consent form. Volunteer opportunities are available to help with the organization and safety of the event.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment amid nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in beautiful, inspiring surroundings.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), with the aim of preserving, developing, and promoting Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folklore performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.

name: Zlatitsa Run
description: Zlatitsa Run is a running event held in the town of Zlatitsa. The course offers a chance to take on a sporting challenge amid the area’s beautiful natural surroundings. The event is suitable for runners of different levels and aims to bring the community together around sport and an active lifestyle.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances for skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in Bulgaria’s natural surroundings, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose between three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
description: Organized by Veloclub Ilchov Bair, the event features disciplines such as cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various courses and are required to follow safety and nature conservation rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Reservoir, Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and an atmospheric experience.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a zero-waste race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.

name: Troyan Run
distance_verbose: 70 km, 69 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 6 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain race held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. It is organized by the “Troyan in the Future” association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced ultrarunners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose between the 48 km ultra distance and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and an opportunity for an active getaway in the national resort of Varshets.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event held along Bulgaria’s longest beach, between Kamchia Resort Complex and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and assistance facilities provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s race. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of the Medicus Hotel. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs are collected at the Varshets Municipality.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. It takes place at a stadium in Sofia and offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talents in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of Bulgaria’s leading athletics organization, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.

name: TRI Legend Batak 2026
description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event held at Batak Reservoir, offering three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay. The race brings together a community of people who push their limits and value friendship and support. The Legend distance is a classic middle-distance triathlon with a 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycle, and 21 km run, while Turbo is shorter and more intense, suitable for beginners. The Relay option allows teams to compete, with each member completing a different discipline.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycle, 21 km run
Turbo: 0.9 km swim, 52 km cycle, 10 km run
Marked course with aid stations and legendary organization
additional: 120 places for the Legend distance, 60 places for Turbo, and 20 teams for Legend Relay. The race promotes community and shared victory. Participants receive a race pack and can enjoy an atmosphere of friendship and support.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional athletics race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of varying fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free but organized running. It is an opportunity for anyone interested to take part in a sporting atmosphere that supports diversity and community.

name: Трявна ултра
distance_verbose: 100 km, 70 km, Маратон, 25 km, Полумаратон, 3000 метра
description: Tryavna Ultra is a mountain race offering varied courses through the heart of Tryavna and the Central Balkan Mountains. The event combines mountain running and cycling with a friendly, family atmosphere, and the routes return to town, where the square comes alive. Participants can choose from different distances and duathlons to suit a range of levels and preferences. Tryavna is known for its cobbled streets, historic architecture, and beautiful forest trails, making the event unique and appealing to mountain enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Courses through the heart of Tryavna, with cobbled streets and historic architecture
Routes in the Central Balkan Mountains, featuring forest trails and scenic natural views
A combination of mountain running and cycling, with duathlon options
additional: The event takes place from 16–18 July 2027, with multiple starts for the different distances and duathlons. It offers a family atmosphere and the option to take part in short and long courses, including the Decathlon 3 km Run. The routes are designed to return to the town centre, making logistics easier and creating a lively atmosphere.

name: XCO National Championship 2026 (ДЛШ и ХОБИ)
location: Knyazhevska Gora Park, Knyazhevo, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: The 2026 XCO National Championship in Knyazhevo is one of the most anticipated events on Bulgaria’s mountain biking calendar. The race features a dynamic XCO course with technical sections and fast descents, creating a true competitive atmosphere. The event is open to both competitors in the National Championship and recreational riders in the Hobby category. Registration is free.
