A valid UCI licence is required for the National Championship, and a temporary Hobby licence is required for the Hobby category.
course_highlights: Dynamic XCO course with technical sections
Fast descents
Competitive atmosphere amid nature in Knyazhevska Forest Park
additional: A valid racing UCI licence is required to compete in the National Championship, while a temporary Hobby licence is required for the Hobby category. Categories are planned for different ages and skill levels.

name: Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain experience. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and demanding mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including routes over peaks such as Botev and Mlechni Chal.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National U18 Championships is one of the largest competitions on the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition includes a variety of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.

name: ТОДОРКА ВЕРТИКАЛ 2026
description: Todorка Vertical is a classic speed ascent in the Pirin Mountains, organized by the AlPirinSki sports club. The race takes place on the steep Tomba and Todorka ski slopes in the Bansko area and offers a test of spirit, willpower, and love of the mountains. The event attracts both serious competitors and children taking part in the children’s course, creating an atmosphere of sportsmanship and positive emotions. The organizers aim to encourage moving uphill and create unforgettable memories for all participants.
course_highlights: Speed ascent on the steep Tomba and Todorka ski slopes
The course is one of the steepest in Bulgaria
Panoramic views of the Pirin Mountains
additional: More than 250 children also take part in the children’s course. The organizers provide race packs and prizes for the winners. The race takes place in a cheerful atmosphere, with the support of numerous partners and volunteers. A one-day insurance policy is included for the classic course; mountain rescue services, a medical team, timing, and photography are provided.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 55 km, 51 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 9 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held around the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 9 to 56 km, with varying difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center. The race is suitable for experienced runners and cyclists as well as enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race pack includes a medal, a souvenir featuring the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. It does not include additional mandatory equipment.

name: Национален шампионат по шосейни бягания
description: The first national road running championship in Bulgaria will be held in Plovdiv. The race features distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as starts for children and beginners. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over 4,000 BGN. It is an important opportunity for amateur and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area around Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from various courses with different difficulty levels and technical features, running amid breathtaking mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of accomplishment on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and remind participants that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is a mountain race offering challenging running and cycling courses in the Rhodope Mountains. The start and finish are at Olympic Square in the town of Chepelare, at an altitude of 1,062 m. The courses pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic trails, reaching a maximum elevation of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances in each discipline, and the event is part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
The highest point of the course is Mechi Chal Peak, at 1,872 m above sea level
Elevation change on the long course: +1,887 m of ascent and -1,885 m of descent
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with a timing chip, a special gift, magnesium, bottled water, and energy food. Every finisher receives a unique metal medal, and participants in both races in the series receive a special wooden medal display stand. Free parking is available at Vasil Dechev Secondary School. Payment can be made by bank transfer, EasyPay, ePay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

name: Balkaniada West
description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race that starts at 06:00. The event includes several distances of varying lengths and elevation gain, with routes passing through scenic mountain areas around Gorski Rai Hut. The event has a limited number of participants, and applications to participate require prior approval. The organizers provide transport, accommodation, and food, as well as branded clothing for those who finish within the time limit.

name: Айтос –Тополица DH 2026 - Квалификации
description: Aytos - Topolitsa DH 2026 - Qualifiers is a downhill race held under the rules of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation. Participants compete in different age categories, with the qualification determining the starting order for the final downhill run. The course is approximately 1790–1810 meters long, with 255 meters of elevation, and is suitable for different age groups. Cash and non-cash prizes are provided for the winners, and riders must wear mandatory protective equipment.
course_highlights: Children’s course (U13, U15), 1810 m long with 255 m of elevation
Course for U17, U19, Elite, Masters, Women, 1790 m long with 255 m of elevation
The course has the same starting point for all categories
additional: All riders must wear a back protector or body armor, and all riders under 18 must wear full body armor. A neck protector and elbow pads are recommended. Every rider will be checked at the start to ensure they have full protective equipment; riders without it will not be allowed onto the course. A valid license from the Bulgarian Cycling Federation is required to participate. Protective equipment is mandatory; riders under 18 must wear a back protector or full body armor.

name: ШОСЕЙНИ БЯГАНИЯ ПЛОВДИВ 2026 - 1 миля

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ранна регистрация до 31.12.2026 г., 23:59 ч. 1 миля 15 €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Късна регистрация от 01.01.2027 г. до 02.03.2027 г., 23:59 ч. 1 миля 20 €

description: Road Races Plovdiv 2027 take place on March 6–7 at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv. The event offers three distances—1 mile, 5 km, and 10 km—suitable for runners of different fitness levels. Organized by SC ACTIVE 2013, the race includes electronic timing, refreshment stations, and medical assistance along the course. Participants receive a unique medal and a chip-equipped race bib, and can enter a prize raffle. The race has a friendly atmosphere and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course is at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv
Refreshment stations and a medical team along the course
Electronic chip timing and official results
additional: The race package includes a cash prize fund for the overall standings, a unique designer medal, a chip-equipped race bib, entry into a raffle with more than 32 prizes, gifts from partners, insurance, water and refreshments at the finish, an electronic certificate of completion, event photographers and host, as well as volunteers and the organizing team. The race package includes a finisher’s medal, electronic timing, insurance, refreshment stations, a medical team, and entry into a prize raffle. Race packages are distributed in the foyer of the Rowing Canal administration building.

name: Adventure Skyrun 2027
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains, offering three challenging distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic natural landmarks such as Mount Malyovitsa, Mount Musala, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km route with extreme climbs, and a 55 km ultramarathon connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race is suitable for beginners as well as experienced runners and mountaineers looking for a true skyrunning experience.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through the ancient pine forests of Rila
25 km route climbing Mount Malyovitsa, with panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
55 km ultramarathon climbing Mount Musala and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: The cut-off time for the 55 km race is 14 hours (until 20:00), with the start at Hotel Rila, Borovets. The cut-off time for the 25 km race is 9 hours (until 18:00), with the start at the Malyovitsa Central Mountain School. Participants must bring their own water container, as bottles are not available at the aid stations. Valid mountain insurance is mandatory for the 25 km and 55 km distances. After the race, transport is organized for 55 km participants to Samokov and Borovets.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain. The course passes peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race combines technically difficult sections with fast descents and demands strength, speed, and skill. Alongside the individual races, there is a team race, as well as the option to take part in a duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, covering 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race requires technical skills for navigating rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and care. The shorter Yastrebets Trail Run, covering 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, is also held alongside it and is suitable for runners looking for an easier route. The organizers also offer a team race and a duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kătina is a mountain running event in the XLkmrun series, held near the village of Kătina, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths, suitable for different levels of fitness. The routes pass along natural trails and cart roads, offering a challenge amid beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park races in Sofia and other cities.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities. The course starts and finishes at the modern Krepost Stadium and passes the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The event offers two main distances: 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and teenagers. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with the region’s cultural and historical landmarks.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra 2026
description: Persenk Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon offering a unique experience in the natural surroundings of the Rhodope Mountains. The courses pass over panoramic ridges, soft coniferous trails, lakes and rock formations, combining challenge and beauty. The race takes place in the Pamporovo resort, known for its natural beauty and comfort. Hotel Perelik is the event’s official partner and host, providing amenities and recovery facilities for participants. The organizers have many years of experience and create a “from friends to friends” atmosphere for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Panoramic ridges and soft coniferous trails
Natural landmarks such as lakes and rock formations
High positive elevation gain of up to 4,550 m on the 100 km distance
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Pamporovo Congress Centre from 19 to 22 August. Mandatory equipment includes a mobile phone, at least 500 ml of water, a whistle, a bell, a survival blanket, a hat, gloves, long trousers and a waterproof jacket with a hydrostatic head of at least 10,000 mm. Hotel Perelik offers premium accommodation and a spa centre for recovery. The race is held on a semi-self-sufficient basis, with aid stations along the course. Electronic timing and live results are provided. The festival programme also includes the 25 km Pamporovo Sky Race and the 20 km Sport Box Trail Run.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of Bulgaria’s leading trail running races, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event brings together runners from around the world, who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.

name: Велокръг Кнежа - 2026
description: Knezha Cycling Circuit is an amateur cycling event organized by the Municipality of Knezha, with the aim of promoting cycling and a healthy lifestyle. The race is held in a criterium format, with three laps on a fast course with little elevation gain and opportunities for sprinting. The start is in front of the municipal building in Knezha. Participation is open to all physically fit cyclists with the necessary skills. The race emphasizes safety and requires participants to sign an informed consent declaration.
course_highlights: Fast criterium course with three laps
Relatively little total elevation gain
Opportunities for sprinting
additional: Race packs are distributed from 08:00 at Akhtirka Park, opposite the entrance to the municipal building. Every participant must wear a helmet, attach the race number with its RFID chip to the bicycle’s seat post, and wear a clearly visible race number on the back of their jersey. Participants aged 12 to 18 must submit a declaration signed by a parent or guardian. For safety, a police patrol will escort riders through the city streets. A helmet and a race number with an RFID chip are mandatory. Motor traffic on the course will not be stopped.

name: Земен рън
description: “Zemen Run” is an athletics event in Zemen, with distances for different abilities—from a short run for children and beginners to a longer challenge. The main distance combines road and mountain running and takes participants through the beautiful area around the town. The start and finish are in the center of Zemen, and the event is part of the Run Bulgaria series.
course_highlights: The main course is about 15 km and combines road and mountain sections.
The route passes between Zemen Monastery and Peshtera Monastery.
There are also shorter distances of about 5 km and 1 km.

name: Adventure Sky Run
location: Borovets, Samokov Municipality, Sofia Province, Bulgaria
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, offering three distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, 25 km of ski trails, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers stunning natural scenery and an opportunity to push beyond your limits.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race in the Western Balkan Mountains and part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series. The race starts at Yordan Radichkov Square in Berkovitsa, at an elevation of 405 m, and the courses climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), offering impressive views of the Danubian Plain, Rila, and the Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for trail running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children’s race and a wide range of activities for children after the race.

name: VITOSHA RUN
location: National Palace of Culture, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Run is an annual mountain-running race in Sofia, organized by the Marathon Association. The course is an uphill route measuring 17.3 km with 1,734 m of elevation gain. It starts at the National Palace of Culture in central Sofia and finishes at Cherni Vrah, the highest peak in the Vitosha Mountains. The race is open to participants aged 15 to 75, with categories for men, women, youth up to 20 years old, and veterans over 45.
course_highlights: Uphill mountain course with 1,734 m of elevation gain
Start at the National Palace of Culture in Sofia
Finish at Cherni Vrah, the highest peak in the Vitosha Mountains

name: Бели Искър рън
organizer: RUN BULGARIA, община Самоков и Българска федерация лека атлетика
description: “Beli Iskar Run” is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and brings runners together in the village of Beli Iskar. Participants can choose between 16 km and 5 km distances, while children and recreational runners can take part in a mass 2 km start. The start and finish are at the village stadium, and the race is part of the sports and cultural program of the Moon Festival.
course_highlights: Choose between 16 km, 5 km, and a mass 2 km distance.
Start and finish at the stadium in the village of Beli Iskar.
The 2 km distance is suitable for children and recreational runners.

name: BELMEKEN SKY QUEST
description: BELMEKEN SKY QUEST is a high-altitude race offering a unique challenge in the rugged, open terrain of the Rila Mountains. The race takes place above 2,000 meters and combines sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. Participants run with almost no course markings and no aid stations, requiring good preparation and self-sufficiency. There are two distances: 34 km with 2,200 m of positive elevation gain and 13 km with 600 m of positive elevation gain, each with a technical, scenic route. This is not just a race, but an encounter with altitude, wind, and your own limits.
course_highlights: High-altitude course above 2,000 meters
Technical course along ridgelines and through open alpine areas (34 km)
Dynamic route with panoramic views (13 km)
additional: The race has almost no course markings and no aid stations, requiring participants to be self-sufficient. Water will be provided only if necessary, if some water sources are dry. The race is almost entirely self-supported: there are no aid stations, and markings are sparse and placed only at mandatory locations.

name: Благотворителен турнир по уличен фитнес TroyanRun 2026
description: The TroyanRun 2026 charity street fitness tournament takes place at the outdoor fitness area of Chavdar Stadium in Troyan. Organized by the Troyan v Badeshteto Association with the support of Troyan Municipality and Dr. Georgi Stoev - Schwartz Multiprofile Hospital for Active Treatment, the tournament combines athletic competition with a charitable cause. The event promotes physical activity and community involvement, with proceeds used to renovate the fitness equipment and support the local hospital. Free preventive check-ups are also offered to help raise health awareness.
course_highlights: Takes place at the outdoor fitness area of Chavdar Stadium
Features various fitness disciplines using the outdoor equipment
Renovated fitness equipment installed at the event venue
additional: Alongside the sports program, free preventive check-ups are offered by urologic oncologist Dr. Milen Tsvetkov to those who register in advance. Proceeds from the tournament are used to renovate the outdoor fitness equipment and make a donation to the local hospital. The tournament is dedicated to a campaign against urinary tract cancer. Free preventive check-ups are planned alongside the tournament for people who register in advance.

name: Teteven's Peaks
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and hiking enthusiast in the beautiful surroundings of the Teteven Balkan. The event features several distances: a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical climb, an easy 6 km route, and a guided mountain walk. Participants will enjoy fresh air, scenic views, and well-organized aid stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, with medals, T-shirts, and personalized bibs with timing chips provided.

name: Via Pontica
description: The cross-border Via Pontica Marathon takes place annually and offers a unique running experience through Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route past Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai, crossing the border without stopping. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with the finish on the beach near the village of Krapets. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Екиден маратон
description: The Sofia Team Marathon is a relay race held at Vasil Levski National Stadium. The event promotes road relay running and commemorates 140 years since the Unification of the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia. Teams cover a total of 42.195 km, divided into six legs of different lengths, with color-coded bib numbers. The race is organized by the Sport for All Sofia in Europe Sports Club and the Bulgarian Sport for All Federation, with the aim of determining the national relay running champions.

name: Пирин ултра
distance_verbose: 160 km, 68 km, 38 km, 33 km, 17 km, 2 km
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers a range of distances suitable for both experienced ultramarathoners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the mountain’s unique nature and challenges. The routes follow scenic trails with impressive views and technical sections that require good preparation and skill. The event combines a sporting challenge with an opportunity to discover the beauty of Pirin.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, including technical sections
Routes with impressive panoramic views and a variety of trails
Passage through key checkpoints and aid stations
additional: For the 38 km and 68 km distances, you must have 2 ITRA points from at least one race before registering. For the 160 km distance, 4 ITRA points are required. Registration includes a medical examination and a check of the mandatory equipment. The drop bag must be handed in on registration day and is transported to the Mandrata checkpoint, which the course passes twice.

name: Бургас Рън
description: Burgas Run is the first running festival in Bulgaria, bringing together recreational and professional runners across various distances in the beautiful city of Burgas. The event offers a variety of courses suitable for all ages and fitness levels, combining sport, fun, and a sense of community. Participants can enjoy a well-organized race supported by volunteers and partners who ensure an excellent experience.

name: Чудобой 2026
description: Chudoboy is a team adventure race combining sporting disciplines with creative and intellectual challenges in nature in the village of Asparuhovo, Varna. The race offers three categories with different technical difficulty levels and course lengths—Elite, Hobby, and Ailyak—suitable for varying levels of fitness. Teams consist of two people, at least one of whom must be an adult. The race is aimed at adventure enthusiasts looking for both a competitive and adventurous spirit.

name: Шосеен пробег „Карнобат”
description: The Karnobat Road Race is a traditional athletics competition organized by Atlet Club (Karnobat) and Karnobat Municipality. The event includes various distances for men, women, and junior athletes, with the course passing through Third of March Central Square in Karnobat. It attracts athletes from different age groups and offers an opportunity for sports competition and the promotion of athletics in the region.

name: 57-ми шосеен пробег „Колю Фичето”
description: The 57th Kolyo Ficheto Road Race in Dryanovo is a traditional competition that brings together running enthusiasts from the region. The event takes place in the town’s picturesque surroundings, offering an opportunity for physical activity and socializing amid the natural scenery and historic landmarks of the area. The race is part of Dryanovo Municipality’s sports calendar and is organized with the support of the local administration.
course_highlights: Races over 300 m, 800 m, and 2,000 m.
Competition categories for different age groups.
Held on the roads of Dryanovo.

name: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026
description: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026 invites you to immerse yourself in the magic of the Elena Balkan mountains with three challenging distances: 12 km for beginners and speed enthusiasts, with panoramic views; 21 km on a balanced course combining technical sections and impressive scenery; and 33 km, combining the dynamism of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route. The event takes place in the town of Elena and promises autumn colors, fresh air, and unforgettable experiences for all participants. Registration is mandatory for everyone over 18, while younger participants have special participation terms.

name: XL kmrun - Кремиковци
description: XL kmrun - Kremikovtsi is an organized 5 km run held in Sofia. The event is part of the 5kmrun series, which takes place in several Bulgarian cities and is aimed at runners of all ages and ability levels. The start is at 9:00, and participation is free, making the event accessible and appealing to a wide range of runners. 5kmrun offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy regular outdoor exercise.
course_highlights: 5 km road run
Held in Kremikovtsi, Sofia
Start at 9:00
additional: Participation is free. The event takes place weekly in several cities across Bulgaria. Special initiatives include 5kmrun FEST and children’s runs. It offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place in late September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and awards points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gains, all qualifying for the UTMB Index and earning points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race number and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the magical Rhodope Mountains.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive 10.25 km long-distance race and a 2023-meter short distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining sea views with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.

name: Pavlikeni Run
description: Pavlikeni Run is a charity run organized by Absolut + Supermarkets in the city of Pavlikeni. The race offers two distances—3.5 km and 7 km—suitable for runners of different levels. The start is at 09:30 on September 25, 2027, at 16 Stefan Karadzha Street, Pavlikeni. The event combines sporting spirit with support for a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Two distances—3.5 km and 7 km
Start at the Absolut + Supermarket in Pavlikeni
The event is charitable in nature
additional: The start for all distances is at 09:30. The organizer is Gergana Georgieva. The event takes place on September 25, 2027, in the city of Pavlikeni. A child may run the distance together with a parent.

name: Чудобой сити 2026
location: Kovshak Cheshma, Aladzha Monastery area, Varna, Bulgaria
price_range: 20 € за възрастни / 15 € за деца под 14 г.
description: Chudoboy City 2026 is an urban competition featuring several stages with different sports disciplines, including mountain biking, archery, climbing, kayaking, logic challenges, and compass orienteering. The competition takes place in the area of Aladzha Monastery, Kovshak Cheshma, Varna, and is part of the European Week of Sport program. Participants compete in teams, with both speed and skills across the different stages being evaluated. The event is organized by SC Chudnite Skali and VK Ustrem, with support from Varna Municipality and the Decathlon store.
course_highlights: Mountain biking stage, with the team time based on the second rider
Archery for points based on the shots
Rowing in tandem kayaks at Karantinata Beach
additional: Technical briefing at 9:30 a.m. in the meadow at Kovshak Cheshma; awards ceremony at 7:00 p.m. in the climbing gym at the former Yuri Gagarin swimming complex; the competition is part of the European Week of Sport program in Varna Municipality. The kayak stage takes place at Karantinata Beach, while archery and climbing are held in the climbing gym at the former Yuri Gagarin swimming complex.

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The international road race “Run for the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.

name: Държавно военно първенство по функционален фитнес 2026
description: The 2026 National Military Functional Fitness Championship is a dynamic and exciting competition held at Artillery Park in Stara Zagora. The competition is divided into two modules. The first includes exercises on a stationary bike and an ergometer, as well as a lap of the park. The second is strength-based and includes jumping over obstacles, push-ups, carrying weights, pulling, and flipping tires. The competition is open to men and women and offers challenges that test both participants’ endurance and strength.
course_highlights: First module featuring exercises on a stationary bike and an ergometer
A lap of the entire Artillery Park
Second, strength-based module featuring obstacle jumps, push-ups, carrying weights, and tire flips
additional: The format includes two modules with different physical challenges, combining cardio and strength exercises. The event is part of a broader public program featuring military demonstrations and equipment displays.

name: Турнир ”Лекоатлетите на Добруджа”
description: The “Athletes of Dobrudzha” tournament takes place in the city of Dobrich and brings together athletes from the region for track and field competitions. The event is organized by the Municipality of Dobrich and aims to promote sport and a healthy lifestyle among the local community. The tournament is held at the renovated “Dobrotitsa” athletics hall, which offers excellent conditions for training and competitions.
course_highlights: Competitions at the renovated “Dobrotitsa” athletics hall
Participation of athletes from the Dobrudzha region
Promotion of track and field and the spirit of sport

name: Balkaniada
description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain skyrunning race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the city of Karlovo. The race offers challenging courses with impressive natural views and varied terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. After successfully hosting the 2025 Masters Skyrunning World Championships, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose from several distances with varying lengths and elevation gain, offering a unique experience amid the wilderness.

name: Шосеен пробег „Варна”
description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional competition held in Varna’s Sea Garden, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The race includes various distances suitable for men, women, and young people, offering athletes from different age groups and clubs the opportunity to compete. The event is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.

name: НАЦИОНАЛЕН УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКИ ШАМПИОНАТ ПО ЛЕКОАТЛЕТИЧЕСКИ КРОС – 2026
description: The National University Cross-Country Championships is a competition that aims to promote student sports within the academic community and crown the national university champions in cross-country running. The event is part of the sports calendar of the Association for University Sports “Akademik” and takes place in Studentski Park in Sofia. The championships offer men and women the opportunity to compete over different distances, fostering a spirit of sporting competition and community among students.
course_highlights: Men’s distance: 5 km
Women’s distance: 3 km
The course is in Studentski Park in Sofia

name: "UNIRUN" Благоевград 2026
description: UNIRUN Blagoevgrad 2026 is a race offering a challenge for everyone—from beginners to experienced athletes. The course is entirely on roads and passes through the heart of Blagoevgrad, with crowd support at every kilometer. The race includes three formats: 5 km, 10 km, and a special Time Attack event for the fastest runners. After the finish, participants can enjoy the UNIFEST festival area with games, a career zone, and healthy ideas. Part of the proceeds go to the “Pirin Without Fires” cause, supporting local forestry services.
course_highlights: An entirely road-based course through the center of Blagoevgrad
Crowd support at every kilometer
Three formats: 5 km, 10 km, and Time Attack
additional: 30% of ticket prices are donated toward purchasing firefighting equipment for forestry services. A VIP package with race entry and a limited-edition T-shirt is available. The event includes UNIFEST with games, activities, and a career zone. Part of the entry fee goes toward firefighting equipment for the Southwestern State Enterprise.

name: ВОАЯЖ - благотворителен Крос срещу Рака
description: The Voyage Charity Run in Plovdiv brings together participants of all ages and fitness levels in support of cancer prevention. The course passes interactive hydration stations and an art promenade featuring inspiring messages about health and prevention. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and after the finish, a large charity Thracian horo is held with FS “Paldin.” The event is organized by the Stop Cancer Association, with the mission of promoting a healthy lifestyle and solidarity in the fight against cancer.
course_highlights: Interactive hydration stations along the course
An art promenade with messages about health and prevention at the start, the little bridge, and the finish
A large charity Thracian horo with FS “Paldin” after the finish
additional: On-site registration is available on the day of the event from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, a personal cause, a T-shirt, a cap, a bandana, and other items. Before the start, there is a morning warm-up with favorite athletes, performers, Era Ballet, and BG Be Active. On-site registration and race-pack collection are available. Participants receive a medal; volunteers and donors can also support the cause.

name: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv
description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv is a corporate relay race and team-building event held at the LIEBHERR factory in Plovdiv. The race features teams of four, with each participant running 4 km by completing two laps of the flat 2 km course. It is the largest corporate run in southern Bulgaria, combining sport, fun, and charity. The event has been held in Plovdiv since 2017 and attracts companies from across the country.

name: Неофит Рилски маратон и колоездене 2026
description: Neofit Rilski Marathon and Cycling 2026 offers a unique adventure, with courses that pass through Bulgaria’s beautiful countryside from the village of Neofit Rilski to Ovech Fortress. The races include running and cycling at various distances, starting and finishing at Historical Park. Participants will face challenges with varying elevation gain and time limits, suitable for different fitness levels. A children’s run with treats is planned for kids. The event is suitable for sports and nature enthusiasts seeking a serious challenge and adventure.

name: Бягане за животните 2026
location: Ezeroto Ariana, Borisova Gradina, Sofia, Bulgaria
organizer: КАЖИ (Кампании и активизъм за животните в индустрията)
description: Running for the Animals 2026 is a charity event held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia, starting and finishing by Ariana Lake. The race is 5 km long and open to all ages, including four-legged participants. Its goal is to support the campaigns of the organization KAZhI to reduce and end animal suffering and exploitation. Participation is free, and everyone can make a donation at their discretion. The event takes place near World Animal Day and carries the motto “The Wide Circle of Love.”
course_highlights: The 5 km course is in Borisova Gradina, around Ariana Lake
Suitable for all ages, with pets also welcome to participate
The event takes place outdoors in a natural urban setting
additional: Registration is free and takes place at the event venue on the day, from 9:30 to 10:45. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony and an introduction to KAZhI’s campaigns. The photography exhibition “The Wide Circle of Love” by Mariana Nordgren can be viewed throughout the day until around 15:00. There are no age restrictions. The funds raised support KAZhI’s campaigns and work.

name: НАЦИОНАЛЕН УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКИ ШАМПИОНАТ ПО ПЛАНИНСКО БЯГАНЕ 2026
location: Vitoshko Lale ski slope, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: The 2026 National University Mountain Running Championship takes place in Sofia on the Vitoshko Lale trail. The competition features two distances—2 km for women and 4.2 km for men—offering students an opportunity to compete in sport. The event is organized by the Association for Student Sport and takes place.
course_highlights: 2 km distance for women
4.2 km distance for men
Vitoshko Lale trail in Sofia

name: Въстаниците на Стара Загора 2026
location: Park "Branitelite na Stara Zagora", Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
description: The Defenders of Stara Zagora 2026 is a sporting event held in the Defenders of Stara Zagora Park. The competition features various running and cycling distances suitable for participants of different age groups, including children. Organized by CC Beroe, the event offers an opportunity to take part in active sport and competition in a pleasant natural setting.
course_highlights: Running and cycling distances in the Defenders of Stara Zagora Park
A range of age categories for children and young people
Competition stages and conditions adapted to participants’ ages
additional: The competition includes numerous age categories for children and young people, with separate running and cycling distances. The organizer is CC Beroe; contact: +359888747071. The event takes place in the Defenders of Stara Zagora Park. The competition supports the cleaning and restoration of trails in Bulgarian Volunteer Corps Park.

name: Бягай с нас - спаси живот 2026 Благотворителен крос в подкрепа борбата с рака
description: The charity run “Run with Us – Save a Life!” in Troyan is a city event supporting the fight against breast cancer. It offers two distances—3 km and 5 km—with the start and finish at Vazrazhdane Square. Each participant receives a themed souvenir T-shirt, and the accompanying program includes an information campaign and preventive examinations. The funds raised are used to purchase medical equipment for the local hospital. The event is organized by the “Troyan in the Future” association with the support of Troyan Municipality.
course_highlights: A fully urban run with 3 km and 5 km distances
Start and finish at Vazrazhdane Square in Troyan
Supporting the fight against breast cancer and the purchase of medical equipment
additional: Preventive examinations begin at 10:00 at Troyan Multiprofile Hospital for Active Treatment. The accompanying program includes an information campaign on breast cancer prevention and early detection. The race pack includes a themed souvenir T-shirt. The initiative is linked to free preventive examinations and an information campaign at Troyan Multiprofile Hospital for Active Treatment.

name: Нови Пазар Рън / Novi Pazar Run
organizer: Българска федерация по лека атлетика, КЛА „Нови пазар“ и община Нови пазар
description: “Novi Pazar Run” is a road race in Novi Pazar, part of the Run Bulgaria series. Previous editions have offered distances of 6.5 and 13 km, as well as a short run for children and beginners. The race combines a sporting challenge with a route between Novi Pazar and historic Pliska.
course_highlights: The 13 km long-distance route connects the center of Novi Pazar with Pliska and back.
The 6.5 km course follows the same route, turning around at 3.25 km.
The 1 km short run is suitable for children and beginners.
additional: The race is the final event in the Run Bulgaria series and is associated with the Novi Pazar holiday.

name: A³ Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
organizer: ККТ „Сърнена гора“, ТД „Сърнена гора“, Вело клуб „Зарата“ и Община Стара Загора
description: A³ Ultra Trail Run & XCM Cycling is an iconic race that brings together Bulgaria’s top mountain runners and cyclists. It takes place in Ayazmoto Park in Stara Zagora and offers a range of courses of varying difficulty, suitable for beginners and professionals alike. The event combines technical routes, beautiful scenery, and an adrenaline-filled experience in the heart of the Sarnena Sredna Gora. Participants can choose from several running and cycling distances, with all courses professionally marked and secured.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty from 6 km to 40 km, suitable for beginners and elite athletes
Panoramic views and varied terrain in the Sarnena Sredna Gora
Professionally marked routes with volunteers at key junctions
additional: The start and finish are at a central meadow in Ayazmoto Park, at GPS coordinates 42.438023, 25.617366. The schedule includes a technical briefing and mass start for cyclists at 08:55, followed by staggered starts for runners at 09:30. The awards ceremony and event closing are at 16:00. Disciplines include mountain running and mountain biking (XCM and E-Bike). Electronic timing with chips is provided.

name: Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
location: Природен парк Сините камъни, Сливен, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: Маратон, 41.5 km, 41 km, 21.6 km, Полумаратон, 13 km, 12 km
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haidushki Pateki Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Balkan Mountains. The course passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine terrain, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses that outlaws used as refuges. The route follows ancient trails used by the outlaws and offers an opportunity to enjoy the area’s nature and history. The race takes place in the last week of October, bringing varied weather conditions and a different level of difficulty each year.

name: Rebel Trails Marathon Reverse
location: Sinite Kamani Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб Стоте войводи – Фондация Стария бряст
description: The “Haidushki Pateki” Marathon is a unique event held in the historic area of Sinite Kamani Nature Park, part of the Balkan Mountains. The course crosses an alpine rocky massif fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses, which were used by hajduks as refuges. The route follows ancient paths used by the hajduks and aims to promote the historic fortresses. The marathon takes place in late October, bringing different weather conditions and levels of difficulty each year.
course_highlights: The course passes through 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
Alpine terrain with bare rocky peaks, ridges, and steep slopes
The route follows ancient hajduk paths that still exist today
additional: The event is organized by Club Stote Voyvodi - Old Elm Foundation. The marathon takes place in Sinite Kamani Nature Park, in the eastern part of the Balkan Mountains. There are several distances: 42K marathon, 21K half marathon, 13K quarter marathon, 10K, and a children's run. The course varies in difficulty and takes place in changeable weather conditions in late October.

name: Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the Varna region of Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of various levels. The courses offer a variety of terrain and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging climbs and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature lovers and mountain runners to enjoy sport and the outdoors together.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain running event that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Elenite area. The race offers four distances—4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K—suitable for runners of different levels. The course follows scenic natural trails and offers a unique experience in nature. The event is part of the international Kom–Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.

name: 34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The “Dimitar Varbanov - Miteto” race in the town of Koynare is a traditional athletics event with a history spanning more than 30 years. It includes half marathons, road races, and track meets. In recent years, a race walking competition has also been held, attracting athletes from cities across Bulgaria. The organizers, the Spartak - Koynare Athletics Club, provide professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for featuring Bulgaria’s top runners and race walkers.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes Race is the first ultrarunning event in one of the most biodiverse regions in Bulgaria and Europe, steeped in the mystique of its centuries-old history. The courses pass through wild, little-known areas, including megalithic monuments and unique natural phenomena, and feature challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners who want to enjoy nature and an adventurous experience. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing, photographers, and support along the route, including for pets.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheitan Dere
Wild, little-known terrain with no marked hiking trails
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
additional: Participants may bring a pet; water and treats are provided at aid stations. Reusable cups or bottles are recommended to reduce plastic use. Course marking, medals, timing, photographers, isotonic drinks, water, fruit, and food are provided. The courses have no officially marked hiking trails, making them suitable for adventurers.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championships in Koynare is a prestigious event that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for competitive races in a natural and challenging setting. The event offers young and experienced runners alike the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment and live results, optimized for mobile devices and computers.

name: Скоростното изкачване на Копитото
organizer: Екипът на Скоростното изкачване на Копитото
description: The Kopitoto Speed Climb is an annual race that challenges participants to climb the trail from Shisharka Bar to the summit of Kopitoto in Vitosha. The event is dedicated to great mountaineering achievements and embodies the spirit of challenge and personal accomplishment. The route has 662 metres of elevation gain and is clearly marked. Every finisher receives a medal and a certificate. The race combines sporting spirit with inspiration and respect for nature and mountaineering tradition.
course_highlights: Start at Shisharka Bar in the Knyazhevo district
Route with 662 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the summit of Kopitoto on a marked trail
additional: Race packets can be collected at 5 Yantra Street, floor 1, apartment 5, from 08:30 to 19:30 on the day before the race. On race day, the race office opens at 08:00 in the start arena area. The start is open between 09:00 and 12:00, with unclaimed race numbers released to those interested at 11:30. Every participant must pass through the start arch to register their chip. The awards ceremony takes place between 12:30 and 13:00 in the courtyard of the Kopitoto tower. If a participant withdraws, they must call the phone numbers provided so that they are not searched for at the finish. The race is dedicated to the memory of Boyan Petrov. Categories are available for men, women, amateurs and veterans; finishers receive a medal and a certificate.

name: Стани Юнак 2026
description: Stani Yunak is a unique obstacle race that brings together active people and athletes from different disciplines. Participants can choose between three courses of varying length and difficulty: Sprint 3 km, Balance 5 km, and Hyper 8 km. Each features a variety of obstacles that require strength, endurance, coordination, and strategic thinking. The race is suitable for beginners and advanced participants alike, offering controlled difficulty and support at every obstacle. After the finish, every participant receives a medal as a symbol of courage and determination, while music, beer, and barbecue add to the atmosphere. Hotel Avenue in Burgas offers accommodation and relaxation facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Three courses of varying lengths: 3 km, 5 km, and 8 km
A variety of obstacles requiring strength, endurance, and technique
Controlled difficulty, with supervision and instructions at every obstacle
additional: The race offers suitable levels for both beginners and advanced participants. Someone is present at every obstacle to monitor safety. Free trial training sessions are organized to help participants find the right group for their level. After the race, enjoy a festival atmosphere with music, beer, and barbecue. Hotel Avenue offers rooms and apartments, along with a restaurant, gym, and parking. A children's category, “Little Yunak,” with 10 obstacles is also planned. Finishers receive a medal.

name: ABO Pharma XL Щафета 4 х 3 х 2.5
description: ABO Pharma XL Relay is a team running event in Sofia, where four participants complete a relay distance of 3 × 2.5 km. Gather friends, colleagues, or teammates and take part in a dynamic race that combines running with team spirit.
course_highlights: A team of four runners
Relay distance of 3 × 2.5 km
Held in the area of Vrana Palace in Sofia

name: Morning Run
location: Детска площадка „Слончето“, Борисова градина, София, Bulgaria
description: Morning Run is an annual cross-country race in Borisova Garden, Sofia, held since 2012 on the last Sunday of October. The course is a 5-kilometre loop, suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers 10 km and 20 km options, as well as a children’s run with athletics games and a warm-up. Every finisher receives a medal, and the awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The organisers provide a bag drop, medical assistance and aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: The course is a 5-kilometre loop in Borisova Garden
An aid station with water, electrolyte drinks and fruit shortly after the start
Start positions based on speed for better organisation and safety
additional: Start times are 9:00 for 5 km, 9:05 for 10 km and 9:10 for 20 km. The Kids Run for children starts at 12:00, with 40 minutes of warm-up and athletics exercises. A bag drop is provided, with volunteers tagging bags. Medical services are available at the start, and an ambulance is stationed in front of the CSKA stadium. Portable toilets are located 50 metres before the start. The start area is at the “Elephant” playground. Electronic timing is provided, and registration is free for participants aged 55+.

name: Първа Пушка Trail 2026
description: Pърва Пушка Trail is a mountain race in Koprivshtitsa that combines sport, nature, and history. The race offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gain, passing through scenic forest trails and open ridges, and reaching Mount Bogdan—the highest point in Sredna Gora. Participants can enjoy the mountain’s autumn beauty and magnificent views of the Rhodope and Balkan Mountains. The event captures the spirit of the April Uprising and Koprivshtitsa’s patriotic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through scenic forest trails and open ridges
Climb to Mount Bogdan (1,604 m), the highest point in Sredna Gora
Cobblestone streets and the historic atmosphere of Koprivshtitsa
additional: The start is at 20th April Square in central Koprivshtitsa. Two distances (25 km and 35 km) are part of the international UTMB Index network and award ITRA points. The 10 km course has a cut-off time of 5 hours and 30 minutes, while the 35 km course has a cut-off time of 6 hours and 30 minutes. In poor weather conditions, the 10 km course may be reversed. The entry includes a race pack with materials and gifts, chip timing, insurance, and medical assistance.

name: LAST RIDE VITOSHA 2026
location: Vitoshko Lale ski run, Vitosha Mountain, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: LAST RIDE VITOSHA 2026 is an open mountain biking event and national university championship marking the end of the active MTB season on Vitosha. Organized by the Academic Association for University Sports (AUS), the event brings together mountain biking enthusiasts and competitors, including MTB and E-bike categories. The course crosses varied mountain terrain with climbs, descents and technical sections typical of XC cycling, in the area of the Vitoshko Lale ski run. The event also supports volunteer trail care on Vitosha, encouraging participants to help protect nature.
course_highlights: Varied mountain terrain with climbs and descents
Technical sections typical of XC mountain biking
The course passes through the Universiada 83 cross-country ski trail
additional: Registration is mandatory and must be completed online; payment is made on site. Every participant must start with a roadworthy mountain bike and a helmet. The event has separate classifications for MTB men, MTB women and E-bike. The program includes a briefing, a 10:00 start, an awards ceremony and a presentation of a volunteer initiative. E-bike participants have a separate start and classification.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the major classics in the Bulgarian RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The course offers varied terrain and scenic views, making it suitable for mountain-running and nature enthusiasts. The event is part of the seasonal series and attracts runners of different ages and fitness levels. Organized by Trail Series, it offers a well-organized event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail route in the village of German with varied terrain
Scenic natural views and mountain landscapes
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event takes place on Sunday from 11:00 to 15:00. The organizer is Trail Series. The location is the village of German, Sofia. No specific prices or different distances have been published for the upcoming edition at this time.

name: Misionis Trail
location: Младост Hut, Parka area, Targovishte, Bulgaria
description: Misionis Trail is a mountain race in the area of the town of Targovishte, starting and finishing near Mladost Hut, close to the historic Misionis Fortress. The race offers courses of varying distances and elevation gain, suitable for runners of different levels, including a children’s course. The course is clearly marked with white tape bearing the race logo, and there are aid stations with food and drinks along the routes. The organizers recommend trail running shoes and navigation devices for added safety.
course_highlights: Courses of 6 km (300 m+), 11.2 km (600 m+) and 28.6 km (1300 m+), with rocky terrain and gradients of up to 25%
Start and finish near Mladost Hut, close to Misionis Fortress
Aid stations with water, food and drinks; no plastic cups
additional: The race uses a contactless electronic timing system, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Overnight stays at Mladost Hut are available to participants. There are age categories and prizes for the top finishers, including for the 45+ groups and company teams in the 6 km Business Run. Participants must wear their race bib visibly at all times to avoid disqualification. Finishers receive a medal, and times are recorded electronically. Trail and mountain running shoes are suitable for the rocky courses.

name: Бягай с усмивка
description: The charity run “Run with a Smile” takes place in the city of Vratsa and supports children with facial anomalies. The event includes several distances—short, medium, and long—with routes passing through scenic spots in the Vratsa Balkan. Participants gather at Hristo Botev Square and run with a smile in support of the cause. The event is a tradition and attracts an increasing number of local runners and volunteers.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Vratsa Balkan, with beautiful scenery and shade along the trails
A loop route with a view of Vratsa’s landmark, Vratsata
An opportunity to support the event and refresh yourself along the route, with panoramic views
additional: All distances start together at Hristo Botev Square in Vratsa. The short-distance route has 60 m of elevation gain and is marked with a GPS track available for download. It includes a climb toward the Vestitel Hut and a scenic trail running parallel to the Leva River. In a previous edition, distances of 5, 11, and 21 km were offered, as well as a children’s course of around 600 m.

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
location: Koynare, Cherven Bryag Municipality, Pleven Province, Bulgaria
description: The Balkan Cross Country Championships are held in Koynare, Bulgaria, and bring together amateur and professional long-distance runners. The course is excellently prepared and offers an exciting experience for participants and spectators. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar and has a tradition in the region.
course_highlights: Excellently prepared course in Koynare
Suitable for long-distance and cross-country running
Balkan Championships with international participation
additional: The competition is held annually and is included in the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The course is suitable for cross-country and long-distance races. The organizer is the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.

name: Emenski Canyon Run
location: Emen Village, Veliko Tarnovo Province, Bulgaria
description: Emenski Canyon Run is a trail race held near the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three distances with varying lengths and elevation gains, suitable for runners of different levels. Participants can enjoy marked courses with aid stations and professional timekeeping. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere for nature and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Trail courses of 8 km (380 m elevation gain), 16 km (600 m elevation gain), and 24 km (850 m elevation gain)
Marked routes with aid stations along the course
Professional timekeeping and race bibs for all participants
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefings before the start of each distance. Participants under 18 must provide a declaration from a parent or guardian.

name: КАРАЙ, БЯГАЙ, ВДЪХНОВЯВАЙ
description: Ride, Run, Inspire is an event that brings together cycling and trail-running enthusiasts amid the beauty of the Balkan Mountains. The route runs from Buhovo to Mount Goten and offers options for both adults, with a distance of 22 km, and children, with a distance of 3 km. The event promotes an active lifestyle, shared experiences, and care for nature, combining sport with a social cause. The organizers invite participants to bring friends and family for a day of movement and fresh air.
course_highlights: Route from Buhovo to Mount Goten
Trail running and cycling amid the natural beauty of the Balkan Mountains
Two routes: 22 km for adults and 3 km for children
additional: The event is part of DRYVIA’s initiatives, which bring people together around social causes through sport and activities. The organizers provide course markings, hydration, and a medical professional along the route. The event promotes nature conservation and responsible behavior among participants. The start is at 11:00. The charitable cause supports the families of Border Police employees and the construction of a monument in their honor.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

name: Маратон Бургас
price_range: от 10 до 50 EUR в зависимост от избраната дистанцията и периода
description:
Burgas Marathon 2026 awaits you on November 15 for an unforgettable run!

Whether you’re chasing a new personal best, preparing for your first half marathon, or simply want to share the excitement of sport with your family and friends, Burgas Marathon offers a distance for everyone.

Choose your challenge:

42.195 km Marathon | 21.097 km Half Marathon | 10.5 km | 5 km |
1 km Decathlon Fun Run – for children, families, and everyone who wants to be part of the running celebration

The course runs along the sea and past iconic locations in Burgas, combining a fast route, beautiful views, and an incredible atmosphere. Participants from Bulgaria and abroad, dozens of volunteers, music, support along the course, and that unforgettable feeling when you cross the finish line await you.

Choose your distance, register, and become part of the event that brings people together through sport, movement, and a love of an active lifestyle.

Burgas Marathon – Run with the pulse of Burgas!
